description.value:
Super Groundcar. Upgrades: TUp (Metalgear Coating [+3 SP, -5 MOVE]) Armored Chassis, Autopilot Terminal, Bulletproof Glass [x2], Bulwark Armor [+2 SP], Communications Center, CrystalCoat, CrystalDome, Improved Engine, Reinforced Tires, Sealed Environment, TUp (Hardwired Locks) Security Upgrade (Advanced). No Housing Capacity or Seating Upgrade. Autopilot at Skill Base 10. Comes with an AirWell 50, a Jeeves garment bag, a DrinkMaster 3000, a Mr. Biscuit food processor, a Streetcase, a WorldSat aerial sphere (in the trunk) and a Porta-Printer. Parked, 30 minutes turns it into Housing Mode: a luxurious space for 3 (no toilet or shower; more than 3 is crammed) that can't move. A month living in it counts as a corporate conapt for your monthly Humanity check (Core Rules, Chapter 13).

Cost: 141,500eb
Nomad: 10
SDP: 50
SP: 18
Seats: 2
MOVE: 70
Speed: 350 mph
